verdict.rationale: Milvus is documented as an open-source vector database that runs locally: as Milvus Lite from a local file, as Standalone in a Docker container or on a single machine, and as Distributed on a self-managed Kubernetes cluster. Community reports of porting it to Jetson Nano and Raspberry Pi corroborate running it on your own hardware. Missing for 10: detailed first-party install and operations guides for Standalone/Distributed in the pack, and independent hands-on reports of production self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Milvus is an open-source vector database that suits AI applications of every size

you can run GenAI apps with Milvus Lite on a laptop or Jupyter Notebook, or Milvus Standalone on Docker container, or Milvus Distributed on massive scale Kubernetes cluster serving billions of vectors in production
Milvus also supports Standalone mode for single machine deployment.
To create a local Milvus vector database, simply instantiate a `MilvusClient` by specifying a file name to store all data
Milvus could run on ARM CPU - ported to Nvidia Jetson NANO and Raspberry Pi 4 (4GB mem) so far
